invariants.rationale: Method calls data.stream(), so data must be non-null.
throwingForeachWrapper(consumer) is called, so consumer must be non-null.
data.stream() gives a stream over all data elements, so counts should match.
It's conventional to require at least one thread for parallelism, though not enforced in this code.
If data is non-empty, its first element should be non-null to avoid NullPointerException when applying consumer.
